parsed.summary: Only the note text in postCharge() changes, from 'charge posted' to 'charge posted.'. No test checks the note, and the index lists no callers of postCharge(), so nobody can tell whether anything reads that text.

findings.title: No test checks the note text, and callers of postCharge() are unknown
findings.detail: The returned value changed at src/payments/ledger.ts:12. The only ledger test, tests/ledger.test.ts:6, checks amountCents and never reads note. It passed, but it would pass with any note text. The code index shows no callers of postCharge(). The call links listed are for checkoutTotal() and importOrder(), which do not touch it. Code elsewhere might compare against, parse, or store the exact string 'charge posted' (for example reconciliation or export code). The file is marked as a critical path. 'Trivial' is the author's claim and is not evidence.
findings.suggestedCheck: Search the whole repo for 'postCharge' and for the string 'charge posted'. List each caller and each place that reads note. Add a test that asserts the exact note value.

findings.title: Validation is said to be preserved, but no test covers it
findings.detail: The author says validation is unchanged. The diff does not touch the check at src/payments/ledger.ts:9, so the risk is low. But the one ledger test only passes a valid amount (94).
